deployments_detail.use: AI to improve cement production, enhancing ball mill performance under its Digital Innovation in Motion ecosystem
NEORIS computer vision system for real-time visual data analysis and vehicle/personnel tracking to optimize supply chain loading

Ball-mill grinding optimization using 'Model-Based Optimization' machine learning to predict mill performance and set material feed speed, separator speed and fan speeds, reducing energy use and improving cement quality; part of the Digital Innovation in Motion ecosystem (in testing/refinement). [Cemex internal (Digital Innovation in Motion)]

AI-powered drone/imagery analytics for quarry stockpile inventory: drones survey French quarries quarterly, Alteia's platform auto-identifies stockpiles in a digital twin and computes tonnage, replacing manual CAD/spreadsheet reporting. In production at Cemex France quarries. [Alteia]

Petuum Industrial AI Autopilot: supervised-autonomous cement-plant operations ('autosteer') giving real-time setpoint prescriptions for kilns, coolers, preheaters and mills. Deployed at select Cemex USA and Mexico plants. [Petuum (with OSIsoft PI System)]

M.A.R.I.A. (Monitoring and Remote Assistance with Artificial Intelligence): AI 'intelligent copilot' capturing real-time sensor data (temperature, oxygen, pressure, vibration) across kilns, mills and fuel-processing equipment, generating predictive alerts and setpoint recommendations. Operating on the 15 plants Cemex runs in Mexico. [Cemex internal (uses 5G/PLC/digital control center)]
deployments_detail.value: ~5,000 alerts/month across ~30 kilns and 50 mills at 15 Mexican plants

deployments_detail.use: OPTIMITIVE real-time closed-loop process optimization AI (Optibat RTO/Studio) to autonomously adjust setpoints and reduce energy consumption at production facilities. Cemex Ventures invested and states OPTIMITIVE has already delivered results in projects across Europe and the US with Cemex, targeting large-scale deployment. [OPTIMITIVE]
Industry-first generative AI tool (with Microsoft) supporting salesforce interactions with clients via real-time assistance

Technical Xpert: generative-AI sales copilot embedded in Microsoft Teams that lets sales agents instantly retrieve product/technical info and tailor material recommendations; reduced technical-inquiry response time from ~1 hour to 9 seconds. Launched in Mexico with global replication planned. [Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service (GPT-4)]
deployments_detail.value: Response time cut from ~1 hour to 9 seconds

[Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure App Service, Microsoft Teams]
deployments_detail.value: 120+ KPIs; 400-500 queries/month; 82% analysis / 92% retrieval accuracy; ~100 executive users

[Cemex internal (Cemex Go platform)]
